```{r}
library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)
library(data.table)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

```


```{r}
meas_directory <- "C:\\Users\\Samantha\\Claycomb Lab Dropbox\\Claycomb Lab Team Folder\\Julie Claycomb\\TURBO ID MANUSCRIPT 04_2026\\Primary Data\\D2005.4\\Azide\\"


# Initialize empty dataframes with column names
df <- data.frame()

# for the means per well (just in case)
quants_df <- data.frame(
  Strain = character(),
  Range = character(),
  Timepoint = character(),
  Treatment = character(),
  Worm = character(),
  meanIntDen = numeric()
)

# Get a list of all txt files in the directory
file_list <- list.files(
  meas_directory,
  pattern = ".txt$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# Loop through each csv file
for (file in file_list) {

  # Read the contents of the csv file
  data <- fread(file, header = TRUE)

  # Extract information from the file name by splitting on "_"
  # and reading from the end, since Strain can contain underscores
  # Format: strain_treatment_worm_time_range_Measurements.csv
  file_name <- basename(file)
  file_stem <- sub("\\.txt$", "", file_name)
  parts <- strsplit(file_stem, "_")[[1]]
  n <- length(parts)

  #working backward: Range, Time, Worm, Treatment
  fluorange <- parts[n]
  timepoint <- parts[n - 1]
  worm <- parts[n - 2]
  treatment <- parts[n - 3]
  strain <- paste(parts[1:(n - 4)], collapse = "_")

  # Add variables to the data frame
  data$Strain <- strain
  data$Treatment <- treatment
  data$Worm <- worm
  data$Timepoint <- timepoint
  data$Range <- fluorange

  # Combine the data with the existing data frame
  df <- rbind(df, data)
}


```




```{r}
# Sum RawIntDen (no area normalization) per worm/timepoint
RawIntDenByTimepoint <- df %>%
  group_by(Strain, Timepoint, Treatment, Worm, Range) %>%
  summarise(
    rawIntensity = sum(RawIntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Range,
    values_from = rawIntensity
  )

# Add ratio per worm, and convert Timepoint to numeric
RatioByTimepoint <- RawIntDenByTimepoint %>%
  mutate(Ratio = higher / lower,
         Timepoint = as.numeric(Timepoint))

# Summary stats on Ratio
ratio_summary <- RatioByTimepoint %>%
  group_by(Strain, Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ratio = mean(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio = sd(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    sem_ratio = sd_ratio / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(ratio_summary,
  aes(
    x = Timepoint,
    y = mean_ratio,
    color = Strain
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(Strain, Treatment), linetype = Treatment),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_ratio - sem_ratio, ymax = mean_ratio + sem_ratio,
        group = interaction(Strain, Treatment)),
    width = 0.2
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = "sans") +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Higher/Lower Ratio (mean ± SEM)",
    color = "Strain",
    linetype = "Treatment"
  )

ggsave(file = paste0(meas_directory, "RatioByTimepoint_mean_07242026.svg"))
```
